worldcombat.skill.calmmind.summary: Stills the mind under a nearly transparent clarity: Special Attack and Special Defense both rise. The only member of its group that raises offense; a deep trance is stronger and longer, a shallow one is instant and always available. Both stages are taken back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.use.0: Open a fight by settling to pad Special Attack and Special Defense together
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.use.1: Sit deep before a hard fight, touch up with a shallow trance in a long trade
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.use.2: Raise Special Defense to take a special attacker's fire
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.description.0: Calm Mind raises Special Attack by %1$s stages and Special Defense by %2$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.deep.on: Deep trance: Sp. Atk +2, Sp. Def +2 and a longer clarity, but 6 ticks more telegraph, a longer cooldown and easy to interrupt.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.deep.off: Shallow trance: Sp. Atk +1, Sp. Def +1, near-instant with a shorter cooldown, always available; both sides have their moment.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.growth.0: At level %1$s the clarity lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.growth.1: At level %1$s the clarity reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.preference.de: On: deep trance, Sp. Atk +2, Sp. Def +2 and a longer clarity, but 6 ticks more telegraph, a longer cooldown and easier to interrupt. Off: shallow trance, Sp. Atk +1, Sp. Def +1, near-instant and always available.
worldcombat.skill.calmmind.preference.ai: Consider a trance when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of meditating; larger gives up setup more often up close.
world_combat.move.calmmind.text.settle: Calm Mind (Sp. Atk +%1$s / Sp. Def +%2$s / %3$s s)
